name: gaps2-construction-same-planet-dock
description: User report follow-up: one space dock per planet on EVERY Construction path. Naalu (holder, pbd105) places a space dock on Qucenn, then presses the stale space-dock picker button for Qucenn again (place_spacedock_qucenn~construction): refused (planet limit 'A planet can hold at most 1 space dock' and Construction's 'second structure must be a PDS'). Rules: a planet can contain at most 1 space dock (LRR 'Space Dock'); Construction primary 'Place 1 PDS or 1 space dock ... Place 1 PDS'.
